gloss: to go along together; to be partners in life

definitions.gloss: to go along together; to accompany each other
definitions.explanation: For two or more people to travel through something together — literally along a road, or figuratively through life as a married couple. Now a dated, literary word; the derived noun {連|つ}れ{合|あ}い (spouse) is far more common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{連|つ}れ{合|あ}った⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧。
examples.english: A couple who have spent many years together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{連|つ}れ{合|あ}ってきた。
examples.english: The two of them have been together since they were young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連|つ}れ{合|あ}って⟦{生|い}きて→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧きた⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: The bond between the two, who lived through hard times side by side, is strong.

notes:
⟦{連|つ}れる→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ (to take along) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to do mutually), so literally 'to take each other along.' The verb itself is old-fashioned and mostly appears in writing; learners meet it chiefly as the source of the everyday noun ⟦{連|つ}れ{合|あ}い→連れ合い：06810_tsureai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{連|つ}れ{合|あ}う: to be together for many years
- {連|つ}れ{合|あ}って⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連|つ}れ{添|そ}う→連れ添う：30494_tsuresou⟧: to be married to — the usual modern verb for living as a married couple
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧: to associate with, to date — everyday word for keeping company
